Wikidata is a collaboratively edited multilingual knowledge graph hosted by the Wikimedia Foundation . [ 1 ] It is a source of open data released under the Creative Commons CC0 public domain dedication. It is for the use of both Wikimedia and external projects. [ 2 ] [ 3 ] Wikidata is a wiki powered by the software MediaWiki , including its extension for semi-structured data , the Wikibase . As of early 2025, Wikidata had 1.65 billion item statements ( semantic triples ). [ 4 ]
